independence_statement: Saved before opening local spot, source, media or prior candidate records for these 25 names. Candidate selection used external discovery only.
method_limits: Coordinates are approximate discovery points and do not prove a launch.
Ukraine verdicts use the current 2026 travel warning as a hard gate.
Georgia is included as a transcontinental European-edge coverage area; Abkhazia is excluded.
Full draft/cloud duplication access remained unavailable.

spots.name: Odesa – Chornomorka
spots.identity: A proposed southwest-Odesa beach sector whose exact active launch is not established.
spots.conditions: General Odesa-region kite use exists, but no dependable exact-source condition profile was found.
spots.access_rules: All non-western Ukrainian regions are under an against-all-travel warning; beach/mine and military restrictions require authorities.
spots.trip_value: Neither current travel viability nor an exact specialist launch is established.

spots.name: Odesa – Arcadia
spots.identity: The dense urban Arcadia bathing beach, not a verified wind-sport launch.
spots.conditions: No reliable source proves recurring specialist use or safe rigging space.
spots.access_rules: Current against-all-travel advice overrides leisure recommendation; urban bathing and coastal security restrictions also require confirmation.
spots.trip_value: A famous resort beach is not automatically a wind-sport destination.

spots.name: Chornomorsk / Sukhyi Lyman
spots.identity: The lyman/yacht-club area by Chornomorsk, distinct from the commercial port.
spots.conditions: Forecast and directory evidence is too generic to prove a current specialist scene.
spots.access_rules: Against-all-travel advice, port security and an exact legal launch must be resolved.
spots.trip_value: Potential regional utility is insufficiently documented and currently not travel-recommendable.

spots.name: Kobleve – Tiligul dam
spots.identity: The kite-school launch on Tiligul Lyman near Kobleve, not the generic resort beach.
spots.conditions: A long-running school network documents shallow flat-water training and weekend-trip use.
spots.access_rules: Current against-all-travel advice blocks leisure travel; re-check war hazards, dam access, school operation and protected-lagoon rules.
spots.trip_value: Strong historic use and accessible flat water could support worth_trip only after the security situation changes.

spots.name: Kinburn Spit
spots.identity: The protected Kinburn/Pokrovska spit complex between the estuary and Black Sea.
spots.conditions: Historic shallow bays and open-water options have high specialist value.
spots.access_rules: The park states the territory is occupied and patrols are suspended; reserve areas need guided access even outside war conditions.
spots.trip_value: Exceptional natural and sport potential is fully blocked by occupation, war and conservation access.

spots.name: Skadovsk – Karzhyny / Lazurne
spots.identity: The Dzharylhach Bay kite sectors west of Skadovsk.
spots.conditions: Shallow sheltered lagoon water and former schools are documented, though independent modelling indicates poor wind reliability at Skadovsk itself.
spots.access_rules: Occupied/war-affected Kherson coast and against-all-travel advice make current access unacceptable.
spots.trip_value: Historic training value exists, but current travel and operating conditions cannot be confirmed.

spots.name: Henichesk / Arabat Spit
spots.identity: The Henichesk–Henicheska Hirka sectors on Utliuk Lyman/Syvash, not the full 100-km spit.
spots.conditions: Former schools used shallow lyman water and multiple wind orientations.
spots.access_rules: The occupied/war-affected Azov coast is under against-all-travel advice; mines, military zones and operator status are unknown.
spots.trip_value: Strong historic flat-water potential is presently blocked.

spots.name: Kyrylivka – Fedotova Spit
spots.identity: The Fedotova/Peresyp spit kite sectors beside Kyrylivka.
spots.conditions: Historic directories and a cross-border tourism source establish wind-sport use in the Azov resort complex.
spots.access_rules: Kyrylivka remains occupied and the region is under against-all-travel advice; coastal safety cannot be assumed.
spots.trip_value: The former resort has credible sport value but no current leisure-travel viability.

spots.name: Berdyansk Spit
spots.identity: The spit and sheltered bay sectors, not the occupied commercial port.
spots.conditions: Shallow flat water, wave alternatives, spring/autumn wind and historic schools are described in detail.
spots.access_rules: Berdyansk is occupied and against-all-travel advice applies; military, mine and port risks are disqualifying now.
spots.trip_value: The historic evidence would support a strong candidate, but current travel is impossible to recommend.

spots.name: Lake Svitiaz
spots.identity: The Shatsk National Park lake and its permitted recreation shores.
spots.conditions: The lake has clear recreational value, but no robust current wind-sport scene or condition source was found.
spots.access_rules: Western Ukraine is still essential-travel-only; the northern lake district also has border permits and national-park constraints.
spots.trip_value: Natural value does not meet the specialist evidence threshold.

spots.name: Vyshhorod / Kyiv Sea
spots.identity: The Kyiv Reservoir windsurf club and kite sectors north of the capital.
spots.conditions: A large fetch, sandy bottom, April–October season, long-running club and national events establish specialist use.
spots.access_rules: Kyiv region is under against-all-travel advice; attacks, martial-law access and critical-infrastructure rules block recommendation.
spots.trip_value: This is a strong historic inland candidate held solely pending safe, lawful travel and current club confirmation.

spots.name: Zatoka / Serhiivka – Budak Lyman
spots.identity: The Budak Lyman school sector near Serhiivka/Zatoka, not the exposed bridge or whole sandbar.
spots.conditions: A former school network documents the exact lyman launch, training and flat-water use.
spots.access_rules: Odesa region is under against-all-travel advice; bridge, coastal defence, mines and current school operation require revalidation.
spots.trip_value: Credible historic trip value is currently blocked by war risk.

spots.name: Ghidighici Reservoir
spots.identity: The established windsurf/kite recreation shore near Vatra, outside motor-sport and bathing sectors.
spots.conditions: Flat water, prevailing northwest wind, instruction and a long-standing local windsurf scene are documented.
spots.access_rules: Pin the current non-motorised launch and verify water quality, swimmer/motorboat separation, rescue and club status.
spots.trip_value: Moldova's main wind-sport lake and Chisinau access support worth_trip after operational correction.

spots.name: Costești–Stânca Reservoir
spots.identity: The transboundary Prut reservoir, with no identified specialist launch.
spots.conditions: One tourism article names windsurfing, but a current club, wind window, launch and rescue are unproven.
spots.access_rules: Border-water permits, dam rehabilitation, navigation and exact recreation zones require authority confirmation.
spots.trip_value: Large size and scenery do not establish a dedicated wind-sport trip.

spots.name: Batumi beach
spots.identity: The urban Batumi seafront, not a verified dedicated kite launch.
spots.conditions: Modelled kite reliability stays below 30% in every month and no authoritative active school/launch source was found.
spots.access_rules: Pin any permitted sector around swimmers, port/airport activity and dense summer use.
spots.trip_value: Excellent city-trip value cannot compensate for low wind reliability and weak specialist infrastructure evidence.

spots.name: Gonio
spots.identity: The pebble resort beach south of Batumi.
spots.conditions: Destination sources prove beach value but not recurring wind-sport use, conditions or a launch.
spots.access_rules: Separate swimmers and border/airport-adjacent constraints; verify any current operator.
spots.trip_value: Generic water activity at a scenic beach is insufficient.

spots.name: Kvariati
spots.identity: The narrow pebble beach between Gonio and Sarpi.
spots.conditions: Official tourism documents diving and motorised leisure, while only a low-authority article claims recent kite schools.
spots.access_rules: Confirm school identities, rigging room, wind reliability, swimmer separation and border proximity.
spots.trip_value: Current evidence is too weak for a specialist travel recommendation.

spots.name: Kobuleti
spots.identity: The long resort beach, outside the protected wetland perimeter.
spots.conditions: Directories label it for kite use, but available modelling is generally light and no active specialist centre is verified.
spots.access_rules: Map any legal launch around swimmers and protected areas.
spots.trip_value: A long destination beach lacks dependable wind and scene evidence for a dedicated trip.

spots.name: Ureki
spots.identity: The wide magnetic-sand beach at Ureki, not the whole Shekvetili–Grigoleti coast.
spots.conditions: May–September thermal west/southwest wind, broad sand and tourist infrastructure are documented for intermediate riders.
spots.access_rules: Confirm a current school/rescue point, swimmer zones and whether modelled rideable hours translate to normal kite sizes.
spots.trip_value: Distinctive black sand, accessible infrastructure and a defined thermal season support worth_trip after operational correction.

spots.name: Maltakva / Poti coast
spots.identity: The Black Sea beach at Maltakva, not the artificial Golden Lake waterski venue.
spots.conditions: The locality has major waterski history on Golden Lake, but that does not prove wind-sport use on the sea beach.
spots.access_rules: Avoid conflating the artificial competition lake, port approaches, Paliastomi protected waters and the coastal launch.
spots.trip_value: International waterski value is out of scope and wind-sport evidence is insufficient.

spots.name: Anaklia
spots.identity: The resort beach south of the Enguri mouth and Abkhazia boundary area.
spots.conditions: A directory claims kite use, but no robust condition or operating source was found.
spots.access_rules: Port construction, river mouth, swimmer zones and proximity to the Abkhazia administrative boundary require current checks.
spots.trip_value: The beach has destination value but insufficient specialist evidence and elevated regional constraints.

spots.name: Tbilisi Sea – Bollywood Beach
spots.identity: The kite-school shore on Tbilisi Reservoir, separate from sailboat, water-ski and aqua-park sectors.
spots.conditions: A local school reports frequent strong wind and boat-supported instruction; official tourism confirms the large recreational reservoir and sailing access.
spots.access_rules: Pin the current school launch and confirm drinking-water, motorboat, swimmer, gust and rescue rules.
spots.trip_value: A distinctive capital-adjacent inland scene supports worth_trip after exact-zone and operator verification.

spots.name: Bazaleti Lake
spots.identity: The resort lake north of Tbilisi, without an identified wind-sport launch.
spots.conditions: Tourism value is established, but recurring wind-sport use and wind reliability are not.
spots.access_rules: Confirm water access, launch permission, rescue and any operator before treating it as a spot.
spots.trip_value: Lake scenery alone is insufficient.

spots.name: Paravani Lake
spots.identity: The high-altitude lake in Samtskhe–Javakheti, mainly discovered as a snowkite candidate.
spots.conditions: Directory evidence supports snowkite interest, not a verified open-water wind-sport season or safe launch.
spots.access_rules: Cold water, remoteness, ice transitions and rescue require specialist documentation.
spots.trip_value: Frozen-lake potential does not qualify an unverified watersports trip spot.

spots.name: Lisi Lake
spots.identity: The small urban recreation lake west of Tbilisi.
spots.conditions: Official tourism documents swimming, boating and water bikes but no windsurf scene.
spots.access_rules: Small size, crowded recreation, swimmers and undefined board-sport permission need confirmation.
spots.trip_value: This is an urban recreation lake, not an evidenced wind-sport destination.
